examples.name: Default
examples.summary: The band as the reach section of a marketing page places it: three figures, each with its unit as suffix and a caption beneath. Edit the items in the Controls panel — a band with no items renders nothing at all.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import StatsBand from '@aziontech/webkit/stats-band'
</script>

<template>
  <StatsBand
    :items="[
      { value: '100', suffix: 'ms', label: 'Median response, worldwide' },
      { value: '24', suffix: '/7', label: 'Support on every plan' },
      { value: '99.99', suffix: '%', label: 'Availability, contractual' }
    ]"
  />
</template>
